name: HandyTech LKR Currency Symbol Changer
author: handytechbloke

sections.description:
HandyTech LKR Currency Symbol Changer is a WordPress plugin that allows you to customize the currency symbol for Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR) in your WooCommerce store. By default, WooCommerce displays the localized Sri Lankan Rupees symbol (රු), but this plugin lets you easily change it to any custom symbol you prefer, such as “LKR” or any other text.

Features

  • Easy-to-use admin settings page
  • Change the LKR currency symbol to any custom text
  • Default fallback to “LKR.” if no custom symbol is set
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration
  • Settings stored in WordPress options for persistence

Usage

After activation, the plugin adds a new admin menu item called “Currency Symbol” under the WordPress dashboard. Simply:

  1. Go to Dashboard → Currency Symbol
  2. Enter your preferred currency symbol in the text field
  3. Click “Save Changes”
  4. The custom currency symbol will now display in your WooCommerce store instead of the default LKR symbol

How It Works

This plugin:
* Registers a custom WordPress setting for currency symbol customization
* Adds an admin menu page with a settings form
* Hooks into WooCommerce’s woocommerce_currency_symbol filter to replace the default LKR symbol
* Supports any text or symbol as the currency representation

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • WooCommerce 3.0 or higher
  • PHP 5.6 or higher

Author

Kasun Rajapaksha

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to the “Currency Symbol” menu item in the WordPress admin dashboard
  4. Enter your desired currency symbol (e.g., “LKR”, “රු”, or any custom text)
  5. Click “Save Changes”
